rule: Only rows with beai_eligible = Y may enter Pipeline A (BEAI / DFM). The Y set is exactly the eight §11 indicators: ACT_GDP_REAL, ACT_IP, ACT_EMP, ACT_HOURS, ACT_RINC, ACT_CONS, ACT_RETAIL, ACT_INV.
enforcement: beai_eligible column; Summary sheet check cell must equal 0.

rule: Financial, credit, price, external, commodity, survey, global and other labour-market series are never BEAI inputs (yield curve, credit growth, stock returns, oil prices, exchange rates named in §11).
Unemployment (LAB_UNEMP) is NOT a primary BEAI input (decision Q-01): §11, §12 and §19 define eight series without it; §14's unemployment rule is illustrative.
enforcement: beai_eligible = N; Summary check counts LAB_UNEMP rows flagged Y (must be 0).

rule: For the eight dual-role concepts the label pipeline (A) and predictor pipeline (B) are separate, versioned transformation sets built from the same immutable raw series. Pipeline B applies the §30 availability lag; Pipeline A applies none. No fitted object (scaler, DFM loading, factor) is shared.
BEAI-derived quantities (Ft, Rt, turning-point flags, diffusion) are not predictors. If one is ever tested it must be registered separately as a lagged, information-available feature.

Label B (Technical GDP) uses only ACT_GDP_REAL; Label C (NBER) uses the external US chronology only. External chronologies (NBER, ESRI, Dua & Banerji, Euro Area dating committee) are plausibility checks, not modelled targets or features.

Under leave-one-country-out, the held-out country contributes nothing to scaling, feature selection, tuning, thresholds, or any global/partner aggregate. Global aggregates are built from training countries only and exclude the target country.
No country ID or raw country-size variable is a feature. Pooled forms are growth, change, ratio, spread, per-capita or cyclical measures.
All scaling statistics come from the training window only. The catalogue stores raw series untouched; no full-sample transform is stored.
Raw 2020 observations are kept unmodified (no winsorising or exclusion at collection). The COVID treatment is a labelling-audit decision fixed before model results (§6, §17).
Predictors need >=70% coverage of the target window to enter a country's feature set (extension of §19, decision Q-25); macro series are never interpolated or forward-filled.

Access-source rule (decisions Q-15, Q-17, Q-30): a series is in scope only if a §7 source hosts it; FRED copies of OECD/BIS data are not used for non-US countries; IMF/World Bank only after OECD and BIS fail.

A quarter needs >=4 core indicators to be dated; a country is BEAI-eligible with >=6/8 core indicators each covering >=70% of the target window (>=101 of 144 quarters, 1990Q1-2025Q4). Failed series stay documented.
